newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar panel to consider production levy refunds.
newsitem.headline: EU sugar panel to consider production levy refunds.

text.p: The European Union's sugar management committee will consider on Wednesday whether refunds should be made to producers under the production levy system, an EU official said.
"If the result of the committee's financial review of the past few weeks is that revenue needed is more than the outlay there could be a question of a refund," the official said.
The committee has been reviewing production and export costs and would have to implement a special regulation for reimbursement, the official explained.
A vote may be taken if there are no new revisions of the figures.
